description: The paired recursion program at \(\langle a,n+1\rangle\) first evaluates its predecessor value \(v\), then its step program at \(\langle a,\langle n,v\rangle\rangle\).
signature:
Nat.Partrec.Code.eval_prec_succ (cf cg : Nat.Partrec.Code) (a k : ℕ) :
  (cf.prec cg).eval (Nat.pair a k.succ) = do
    let ih ← (cf.prec cg).eval (Nat.pair a k)
    cg.eval (Nat.pair a (Nat.pair k ih))
